name: Ocean Drive Strip
summary: The neon heart of Vice City. Art-deco hotels, nightlife, and the busiest cruising strip in Leonida.

name: Vice Beach
summary: Packed sands, muscle beach equipment, and airliners on final approach overhead.

name: Port Gellhorn Speedway
summary: A run-down oval speedway on the gulf side — dirt-track racing and demolition events.

name: Kelly County Airstrip
summary: A cracked crop-duster strip in sugarcane country. Rumored spawn for utility aircraft and smuggling runs.

name: Mount Kalaga Overlook
summary: A scenic overlook deep in the national park. Prime candidate for a photo-spot collectible chain.

name: Leonida Keys Marina
summary: Sport-fishing charters and cigarette boats moored along the old highway causeway.

name: Little Cuba
summary: Cafecito windows, domino tables, and low-slung classics on gold wire wheels.

name: Grassrivers Airboat Dock
summary: Swamp-tour airboats and half-sunk hulls at the edge of the wetlands.

name: Hidden Mural — Port Gellhorn Pier
source: Fan speculation from trailer background art
summary: A weathered mural on the old pier warehouse — a likely anchor for a photo-collectible chain along the gulf coast.

name: Vice City Valet Plaza
summary: Valet stand outside the downtown hotel cluster where the Jastic was first spotted.
